en.headline: M+ fantasy exhibition opens in the West Gallery on 17 October
en.dek: Myths and Monsters runs until 4 April 2027 on level two, tracing fantasy in Asian visual culture from the nineteenth century to the present.
body: M+ will open Myths and Monsters: The Art of Fantasy in Asia on 17 October in the West Gallery on level two. The museum says the exhibition runs until 4 April 2027.

The show looks at fantasy as a strand in Asian visual culture, and at how artists have used imagined stories, characters and worlds. It is arranged in four chapters. The first takes in older forms, including Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock prints, Chinese shadow puppetry and Tibetan Buddhist scrolls. Later chapters follow the spread of surrealism in Asia, the post-war rise of Japanese manga and anime, and the way those aesthetics have moved into art, design, architecture, film, fashion, games and digital culture.
The museum is selling tickets. Its exhibition page does not list a standard admission price or a work count. The gallery is inside M+ in the West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: M+西展廳10月17日展開「神話與怪獸」展覽
zh.dek: 「神話與怪獸：亞洲的奇幻異境」展至2027年4月4日，在西九M+二樓西展廳舉行，梳理十九至二十一世紀亞洲視覺文化中的幻想。
body: M+將於10月17日在二樓西展廳展開「神話與怪獸：亞洲的奇幻異境」，博物館表示展覽至2027年4月4日。
展覽探討幻想在亞洲視覺文化中的位置，以及藝術家如何以虛構故事、人物和世界回應時代變化。全展分四章。首章包括日本浮世繪、中國皮影戲和西藏唐卡等較早的形式。其後各章追溯超現實主義在亞洲的傳播、戰後日本漫畫和動畫的興起，以及這些美學如何進入藝術、設計、建築、電影、時尚、電子遊戲和數碼文化。
博物館現正發售門票。展覽頁面未列標準票價，也未列展品數目。場地在西九文化區M+館內。
